data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,type,created_by,colonists_ore,ore_production_remainder,production_last_tick,slave_unrest_next_at) SELECT 1,'v3_pop05_remainder_qa',player_id,'player','M',100,'SLAVE',pt.planettypes_id,player_id,100,17,-1,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1 FROM players CROSS JOIN planettypes pt WHERE players.name='System' AND pt.code='V3_POP05_REM_QA';

tests.name: Run an actual production cycle while daily stoppage is active
Assert production remainder, stoppage and population loss are conserved

data.sql: SELECT population,slave_unrest_stopped::int,ore_production_remainder,(SELECT COALESCE(quantity,0) FROM entity_stock s WHERE s.entity_type='planet' AND s.entity_id=p.planet_id AND s.commodity_code='ORE'),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e WHERE e.planet_id=p.planet_id),(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(applied_population_loss),0) FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e WHERE e.planet_id=p.planet_id) FROM planets p WHERE name='v3_pop05_remainder_qa';
